classification: No earned wage access bill in the 2025–26 session. A search of the General Assembly’s site for “earned wage” returned only two unrelated bills (SB 69 and SB 608), checked Oct. 12, 2026. No Department of Banking and Securities guidance found.

Two 2023 bills, HB 1921 and SB 1217, would have licensed providers through the State Corporation Commission; both failed in conference. A search of the Legislative Information System for “earned wage” returned no 2025 or 2026 bills, checked Oct. 12, 2026.

SB 117 (Sen. Lang) and HB 152 (Reps. Williams and Upchurch) would declare earned wage access not “a loan or other form of credit” and require registration with the Division of Financial Institutions. Both remain in committee; the last hearings were Sept. 30 and Nov. 5, 2025.

SB 282 would have declared compliant earned wage access not a loan and capped fees at the greater of $5 or 5 percent per transaction. It was withdrawn and recommitted on Feb. 12, 2026, as reported, and did not pass.
